promises.quote: The BMC will also highlight this issue in our guidance, suggesting that climbers consider telling others of their plans and their expected return time.
promises.summary: Highlight issue in guidance to climbers to consider telling others of plans and expected return time

promises.quote: The RYA will be highlighting this safety information to its members through various electronic communications in the early part of this year, as well as in the RYA's annual Safety Advisory Notice.
promises.summary: Highlight safety info to members via communications and annual notice

concerns.quote: He was climbing with no safety line
He was not wearing a lifejacket or buoyancy aid
He was not wearing clothing that offered no warmth in the water
He had no means of requesting help such as a whistle, a waterproof phone or waterproof marine VHF radio
He had left no specific instructions as to where he was intending to climb and what time he would be home

reports.title: David Haw: Prevention of Future Deaths Report

concerns.quote: Sailing is by its nature an unpredictable sport and therefore inherently involves an element of risk
concerns.hazard: use of pleasure vessels as commercial vessels

concerns.quote: there is currently no legislation prohibiting the use of alcohol or drugs by those who are helming a vessel for private or pleasure use,
concerns.hazard: alcohol or drug impairment of vessel helms

concerns.quote: The current legalisation, The Merchant Shipping (Life-Saving Appliances and Arrangements) Regulations 2020, only requires pleasure vessels of over 13.7 metres in length to carry lifesaving appliances
concerns.hazard: absence of mandatory lifejackets on all vessels

concerns.quote: support boats, often RHIBs, at sailing events or regattas, and particularly when they are used outside of the designated sailing time but in a way linked to the event
concerns.hazard: use of support boats as taxis at social events

concerns.quote: I have concerns that there is a culture of using such support boats as a form of taxi particularly at the social events, albeit not for pecuniary gain
concerns.hazard: culture of using support boats as taxis

concerns.quote: Under Rules 89 and 90 of the World Sailing Racing Rules of Saling (RRS20212024Finalwithbookmarks-[27255].pdf) (The Rules) there is a requirement for race organisers to issue a "Notice to Race" and "Sailing Instructions
concerns.hazard: lack of mandatory support boat regulations

links.explanation: Both reports identify the absence of lifejackets or buoyancy aids as a contributing factor to potential drowning deaths. The earlier case involves an individual climbing over deep water without a lifejacket, while the later case highlights a regulatory gap that leaves pleasure vessels without mandatory lifejacket carriage or wear.
links.earlier_quote: He was climbing with no safety line He was not wearing a lifejacket or buoyancy aid He was not wearing clothing that offered no warmth in the water
links.later_quote: Further, I have a concern that personal floatation devices, such as lifejackets or buoyance aids are not legally required to be carried on all vessels, nor is there any legal requirement to wear lifejackets.
links.promise_quote: The RYA will be highlighting this safety information to its members through various electronic communications in the early part of this year, as well as in the RYA's annual Safety Advisory Notice.
